blurb: Guests play paintball on large fields with a minimum of 10 players required to start a game. The facility enforces safety briefings and requires waivers for all players. Equipment is reserved with a deposit and paintballs must be purchased on site.
extraNote: $5 deposit per player is non-refundable and not creditable if no-show · No outside paintballs allowed; field paint only · No alcohol or animals allowed on property · Only law enforcement may possess weapons on property · No returns on paintballs purchased · Late arrivals may miss games and safety briefing; no hold-ups for late players
